The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Shala]] used a base of operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Courkrus]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] there while trying to trap the "Ghost Jedi", [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].
